Wonder Masters 5 Gets A Reboot!


Wonder Masters 5 is a side-scrolling RPG that was released for the mobile in Korea. However the game previously published by Actoz Games 2 years ago didn’t make it far. Now the developer of the game, Jellyoasis is grabbing it by their hands and rebooted the game for a mobile re-launch! Currently, the game is already made available for Android users in the Philippines dubber Wonder Masters 5 R so it is only a matter of time for the game to be released to all!   You may have played the game before or are familiar with side-scrolling games like the late DoTArena, Seven Knights and others, this is a little different. There is a feature unlike other in their Skills System. Players will be able to target their skills rather than just auto casting it while you pray to RNGesus that your skills hit the right target. This game requires players to Drag the skill and Drop it on the area or enemy you want to cast upon.

Like many of the RPGs out there, there will be Campaign Modes, PvP, PvE, Guild Battles and Boss Raids. So check the game out if you are keen and for Android users, download it now! You can also check out their official Facebook page for more future updates and events!

reference_summary: Wonder Masters 5, RPG tatal sisi yang asalnya diterbitkan oleh Actoz Games, sedang dibut semula oleh pembangun Jellyoasis untuk pelancaran semula mudah alih. Permainan ini menampilkan sistem kemahiran yang unik di mana pemain boleh menyasarkan kemahiran mereka, bukannya penghantaran automatik. Ia termasuk mod kempen, PvP, PvE, pertempuran persatuan dan serbuan bos. Kini tersedia untuk pengguna Android di Filipina sebagai "Wonder Masters 5 R," hanya menunggu masa sebelum keluaran global. Ikuti halaman Facebook rasmi mereka untuk kemas kini dan acara.
